decision_logic.recommended: nmck >= 100000 AND calculated_price >= min_service_threshold AND ((category != 'goods' AND margin_percent >= 15) OR (category == 'goods' AND nmck <= 300000 AND margin_percent >= 5)) AND no_forbidden_directions AND risk_level == low
decision_logic.conditional: nmck >= 100000 AND calculated_price >= min_service_threshold AND margin_percent >= 10 AND margin_percent < 15 AND no_forbidden_directions AND risk_level != high
decision_logic.reject: nmck < 100000 OR calculated_price < min_service_threshold OR has_forbidden_directions OR (category == 'goods' AND (nmck > 300000 OR margin_percent < 5)) OR (category != 'goods' AND margin_percent < 10) OR risk_level == high
